request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Sons of Gad are named in the list
Zephon and Haggi hold the thread
Shuni and Ezbon join the line
Eri and Arodi stand the test
Areli completes the seven names
A family bound by blood and bone

[Verse]
Seventy souls went down to Egypt
Jacob’s house escaped the famine’s grip
Joseph held power in that land
But the family kept their ancient trust
Sixty-six direct descendants came
With wives excluded from the count

[Chorus]
Clan of Zephon in the census
Counted on the plains of Moab
Clan of Zephon in the record
Part of Gad’s enduring name

[Verse]
Israel settled in the land of Goshen
Acquired property and grew
Fruitful and increased in number
A great nation from the seed
Zephonite clan within the tribe
A memory kept in the book

[Chorus]
Clan of Zephon in the census
Counted on the plains of Moab
Clan of Zephon in the record
Part of Gad’s enduring name

[Bridge]
From Jacob’s sons to the desert
The lineage flows like a river
Zephon and Haggi and Shuni
Their names remain in the scripture

[Outro]
Seventy persons came to Egypt
The story lives in the text
